hooks.name: Skills Auto-Activate
hooks.description: Automatically activates relevant skills at session start. deploy-to-vercel is NOT auto-activated — requires explicit user approval via deploy-gate hook.

action.prompt:
Activate the following skills for this session:
1. "caveman" - Communicate in caveman style to reduce token usage while maintaining full technical accuracy.
2. "find-skills" - Helps discover and install agent skills.
3. "frontend-design" - Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design.
4. "git-commit" - Execute git commit with conventional commit message analysis.
5. "supabase" - Use for ANY task involving Supabase.

IMPORTANTE: NO activar "deploy-to-vercel" automáticamente. El deploy a producción requiere aprobación explícita del usuario. Solo activar la skill cuando el usuario APRUEBE el deploy (dice 'sí', 'dale', 'aprobado', 'mergea', 'libera').
